description:
Port-map §6. Pre-diff composition of overlay components onto the
base screen.

- OctoPi.Tui.Overlay struct: position (anchor + offset + %), size
  (width/height + min + max + %), z-index, content lines, margin.
- composite/3: take base_lines, overlays (sorted by z), width,
  height → composite line list ready for diff.
- compute_rect/3: resolve anchor + margin + offset + %/absolute
  into concrete (row, col, w, h) — multi-head dispatch on anchor
  atom, not if/case.
- Width-overflow clipping via visible-width helper (§5).
- OSC 8 hyperlink re-emission on overlay edges.

Tests: port-map §14.5 (overlay-options.test.ts, 538 lines) —
lift the anchor/margin/offset/% matrix directly.

TDD:
- Every anchor: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right,
  top-center, etc.
- Margin as number (uniform) and as map.
- Negative margins clamped to zero.
- Offset from anchor.
- Row/col as percentages.
- Absolute row/col overrides anchor.
- maxHeight absolute + percent.
- Stacked overlays (later on top).
- Overlay hide pops the stack.
- OSC 8 in base content doesn't crash.

Depends on .5.
title: Overlay compositor: z-ordering + clipping + composite
